items.name: Amina
items.label: bina parent
items.quote: bina has been a blessing for our family, it keeps me closely involved in my son's learning while giving him structure, confidence, and a nurturing school community that shares our values.

items.name: Makeda & Steve
items.label: bina parents
items.quote: We were exhausted and losing connection. Since joining bina, our daughter is calm, confident, and learning joyfully and no more after-school tantrums.

items.name: Lorena
items.label: bina parent
items.quote: My daughter’s passion for learning and friendships has grown tremendously. The teachers at bina nurture her independence, confidence, and emotional awareness beautifully.

items.name: Amanda
items.label: bina parent
items.quote: bina has been a bright spot for our family. The small, live classes and caring teachers helped our children grow in confidence, learning, and connection.

items.name: Mo & Ayo
items.label: bina parents
items.quote: Small classes, whole-child focus, and ability-based learning have helped our daughter’s confidence and curiosity blossom. With bina, she thrives and our family flourishes.

items.name: Mary Kate
items.label: bina parent
items.quote: After years of searching for "a better way" in virtual education, I finally found it with bina, where my boys are seen, supported, and thriving every day.
